ai_risk_policy.medium: Show evidence and suggest teacher review.
ai_risk_policy.high: Require teacher review; do not automatically deduct marks.

criterion_scoring_bands.full: 90-100% of criterion marks: complete, accurate, and supported by evidence.
criterion_scoring_bands.partial: 40-69%: relevant but incomplete or weakly supported.
criterion_scoring_bands.minimal: 1-39%: limited evidence or major conceptual problems.

format_policy: Malformed submissions are quarantined and require teacher approval before grading.
late_policy: Late submissions are flagged; any penalty is decided by the teacher.
